answer: Each submission hangs on the ferrous of a task receipt, and the juniper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cedar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
